title: Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. translated_title: 迈向高棉语文本识别与分词的联合框架
translated_abstract: 文本识别，即从文档图像中提取电子文本，对于检索增强生成（RAG）等知识检索任务而言不可或缺。对于高棉语而言，提取出的文本还需要额外的分词步骤，因为高棉语不使用任何可见的词分隔符来标示词边界。因此，针对高棉语的“先识别后分词”流程需要两个独立的串行模型，这不仅容易出错，还会给大规模文档处理带来显著的延迟。本文提出了一种新颖的统一模型框架，将高棉语文本识别与分词联合处理。所提出的模型使用联结主义时序分类（CTC）解码器实现快速并行解码，并可通过指令控制其在带分词（b=1）与不带分词（b=0）两种模式下识别高棉语文本。在不同文档模态（印刷文档、场景文本和手写文本）的多个基准数据集上的实验结果……
tldr: 本文提出一个统一模型，将高棉语文本识别与分词联合处理，利用CTC解码器实现快速并行解码，并可通过开关控制是否分词，从而避免了传统两阶段串行流程的错误累积与高延迟问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified model that jointly performs Khmer text recognition and word segmentation using a CTC decoder for fast parallel decoding, with a switchable option for segmentation, avoiding the error-prone and latency-heavy two-stage pipeline.
